g.text: Detailed inspection view at 30s bins, 175 inches wide. Scroll horizontally to inspect local structure. 'No recording active' means no recording file in this dataset covers the interval. It does not mean nobody on the fire-ground was speaking. Temporal overlap means only that two or more recording intervals cover the same wall-clock time. It does not establish on-air collision, stepped-on transmission, interruption, message loss, or channel saturation.
